faqs.question: How is Fit Monk Dryfruits, Seeds and Fruits Muesli served?
faqs.answer: It can be served with cold or warm milk, stirred into curd or yogurt, or soaked overnight as an overnight muesli bowl.

faqs.question: Are there multi-pack discount offers on this muesli?
faqs.answer: Yes, the catalog features an offer to buy two 500g packs (1000g total) for ₹699 with free shipping.
